channel.title: The Latin Wire
channel.description: Politics, business, entertainment, sports and culture for Hispanics

item.title: AFA honours Messi as Scaloni prepares first post-Messi squad
item.description: Messi exits with 207 caps and 125 goals as Scaloni readies a 26-man roster and a China friendly falls apart.

item.title: Trump pledges to campaign in 35 races in final 30 days
item.description: Trump's Rose Garden pledge to sprint through 35 competitive races revives an old question: how much does a president's late-campaign presence actually move votes?

item.title: Republicans face 2026 midterm headwinds as corruption poll hits high
item.description: A Gallup poll showing record-high corruption concern and Democratic gains in special elections are complicating Republican calculations ahead of the 2026 midterms.

item.title: Maine high court upholds father's veto over daughter's church attendance
item.description: Maine's highest court unanimously upheld a lower court order giving a divorced father final say over his daughter's attendance at an evangelical church.

item.title: Trump renames Lake Ontario 'Lake America' amid Canada trade war
item.description: President Trump signed an executive order renaming Lake Ontario 'Lake America' on August 27, 2026, drawing immediate objections from Indigenous leaders and local officials.

item.title: FAA proposes permanent flight restrictions around Mar-a-Lago
item.description: The FAA is seeking public comment through October 2 on a rule that would make security airspace around President Trump's Florida estate permanent.

item.title: Jeffries under pressure over socialism vote fallout and Kushner meeting
item.description: House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries faces internal discord over a socialism-resolution defection and questions about a private meeting with Jared Kushner.

item.title: Argentina's UIA clashes with Milei government on Industry Day
item.description: UIA president warns industrial output is 10% below 2022 levels and 90,000 jobs have vanished since August 2023.

item.title: New Jersey petitions Supreme Court over Kalshi prediction market jurisdiction
item.description: A circuit split over prediction market jurisdiction forces a question the country has quietly avoided: who ultimately governs the digital wagering economy?

item.title: Mexican defender Rebeca Bernal signs with Manchester United Women
item.description: The 29-year-old central defender becomes the first Mexican player in the Women's Super League, signing a three-year deal with Manchester United Women.

item.title: Judge blocks Trump's 'birth tourism' birthright citizenship order
item.description: A federal judge in Maryland has blocked enforcement of President Trump's August 2026 executive order targeting birth tourism, finding it likely unconstitutional.

item.title: Mexico women's team to face Jamaica in two October friendlies
item.description: Mexico hosts Jamaica on October 9 and 13 in tune-up matches before a November quarterfinal that puts World Cup and Olympic spots on the line.

item.title: Missouri Supreme Court hears redistricting and initiative-protection ballot cases
item.description: The Missouri Supreme Court heard oral arguments September 2 in three cases that could determine whether two measures appear on the November ballot.

item.title: ICE arrests hit monthly record as enforcement actions widen nationwide
item.description: ICE logged 49,571 arrests in July 2026, its highest monthly total under President Trump, as disputes over who is being detained intensify.

item.title: Danbury, Connecticut holds 'Day Without Immigrants' after ICE raids
item.description: Activists called for a work and commerce stoppage after ICE detained roughly 70 Danbury-area residents in about one week.

item.title: Red Bull New York loans Honduran midfielder David Ruiz from Inter Miami
item.description: Red Bull New York lands 22-year-old defensive midfielder David Ruiz on loan from Inter Miami through the end of the 2026 MLS season.

item.title: House passes continuing resolution to fund government through Dec. 11
item.description: A lopsided House vote buys Congress ten more weeks — and raises familiar questions about whether short-term patches are becoming a permanent governing mode.

item.title: Erik Lira stays at Cruz Azul after Monaco transfer collapses
item.description: Monaco could not free a non-EU roster slot in time, leaving the 26-year-old captain at Cruz Azul through at least the next tournament.

item.title: Chile's economy contracts 1.5% in July, dragged by mining slump
item.description: Chile's Imacec fell 1.5% in July year-on-year, the worst reading of 2026, as mining output cratered 9.3% on lower ore grades and storms.

item.title: House defeats amendment to fix Supreme Court at nine justices
item.description: The House voted 212–206 to reject H.J. Res. 1, falling far short of the two-thirds majority required to advance a constitutional amendment.

item.title: Kennedy Center removes Joel Shapiro's 'Blue' sculpture without notice
item.description: Workers used a crane to remove Joel Shapiro's 24-foot aluminum sculpture from the Kennedy Center grounds on September 2, 2026, without prior public announcement.

item.title: US asylum denials hit record 94% as ICE arrests near 50,000 in August
item.description: Immigration courts denied 94% of asylum cases in June 2026 as ICE arrests approached 50,000 for a second consecutive month.

item.title: NYC bans generative AI in public schools through 8th grade
item.description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Schools Chancellor Kamar Samuels announced a one-year moratorium on student-facing generative AI for grades 2-K through 8.

item.title: Coast Guard jet carrying DHS Secretary Mullin makes emergency landing
item.description: A Coast Guard C-37A carrying Secretary Mullin declared an emergency after losing its right engine on a flight from Georgia to Washington.

item.title: Messi scores four goals for Inter Miami, retires from Argentina
item.description: Messi netted four goals and an assist Sunday as Inter Miami routed CF Montréal 7-1, then announced his Argentina retirement Monday.

item.title: Caputo and Daza tout international backing after G20 finance summit
item.description: Caputo and Daza returned from the G20 summit in North Carolina claiming broad international support for Argentina's economic program.

item.title: Massachusetts primaries test incumbents amid Wu-backed challenges
item.description: Massachusetts's September 1 primaries revealed how a 2024 property tax dispute is quietly reshaping the balance of power between Boston City Hall and Beacon Hill.

item.title: Inter Miami sells homegrown defender Noah Allen to Chicago Fire
item.description: Inter Miami sells homegrown defender Noah Allen to Chicago Fire for $3 million, ending a six-year run that produced three trophies.

item.title: Chevron pledges $7 billion as US and Venezuela sign eight energy deals
item.description: Venezuelan acting President Delcy Rodríguez and U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright signed eight energy agreements in Caracas on September 2.

item.title: Rising commodity prices boost Argentina's economic outlook to 2030
item.description: Soybeans, wheat, and corn prices surge on global markets, putting $24.3 billion in Argentine export value on the table ahead of a projected 2030 GDP of $833 billion.

item.title: US Mint releases Trump $1 coin into circulation on Sept. 2
item.description: The manganese-brass dollar, part of the 2026 Semiquincentennial series, went on sale exclusively through the Mint's website at noon Eastern time.

item.title: Apple Maps relabels Lake Ontario 'Lake America' after Trump order
item.description: Apple Maps relabeled Lake Ontario as 'Lake America' for U.S. users Tuesday, following a Trump executive order tied to the Canada trade dispute.

item.title: Chile's economy contracts 1.5% in July, worst result since 2023
item.description: Chile's Imacec fell 1.5% year-on-year in July, its weakest reading since March 2023, as mining collapsed and manufacturing stumbled.

item.title: Mexico national team poaches Club Puebla's team doctor
item.description: Club Puebla loses its head doctor to the Mexican national team just as injuries pile up, and Alfredo Talavera reveals why Márquez passed on him.

item.title: US strikes Iran; Iran retaliates against Gulf allies with missiles and drones
item.description: Tuesday's exchange of strikes and retaliations follows a logic older than any single administration—escalation ladders are easier to climb than to descend.

item.title: Félix Pago raises $200 million to expand beyond remittances
item.description: The Miami fintech closed a $200 million package on September 1, 2026, to move beyond money transfers into lending, savings, and AI tools.

item.title: New Jersey petitions Supreme Court in Kalshi sports-betting dispute
item.description: New Jersey asked the Supreme Court on September 2 to decide whether states can enforce gambling laws against prediction market operator Kalshi.

item.title: Erik Lira's move to Monaco collapses on transfer deadline day
item.description: A salary dispute between Folarin Balogun and Everton killed the Monaco roster slot Lira needed, ending an €11 million deal hours before the window closed.

item.title: Paredes uncertain on Argentina future after ban and Messi retirement
item.description: A 10-match FIFA ban and Lionel Messi's international retirement have Leandro Paredes questioning whether he will ever play for Argentina again.

item.title: Inter Miami sign 19-year-old Brazilian winger Riquelme Fillipi from Palmeiras
item.description: Inter Miami land 19-year-old Brazilian winger Riquelme Fillipi from Palmeiras for up to $6 million through 2030.
